title: luscious creamy summer dutch temper paella
description: nutty, creamy, and monsoon-drenched dutch dish featuring grape tomatoes and temper, all in a paella pan.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the temper and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, white wine, and heavy cream.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan cheese and season with salt to taste.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese and grape tomatoes if desired.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
